description: R-PAR-1 PAR-ERROR, SQL-DEMAND, SQL-AGG-OCCUR: At which call does an erroring argument surface inside an aggregate (zm = 0 at id 100, zl = 0 at id 240, zf = 0 at id 3): Sum, Avg, Count, Min and Max of 1 / zm; Sum of 1 / zl and of 1 / zf; Count(*) beside Sum(1 / zm); Sum with WHERE id <> 100, id < 100 and id <= 100; Sum over derived tables with TOP 10, TOP 150 ORDER BY id and WHERE id < 50; and grouped forms (GROUP BY id Mod 2; GROUP BY id \ 100 with and without HAVING Sum(1 / zm) > 0; GROUP BY CLng(tx); DISTINCT 1 / zm)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-error opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.

args.text: SELECT Sum(1 / zm) AS s FROM ER
SELECT Avg(1 / zm) AS a FROM ER
SELECT Count(1 / zm) AS c FROM ER
SELECT Min(1 / zm) AS mn, Max(1 / zm) AS mx FROM ER
SELECT Sum(1 / zl) AS s FROM ER
SELECT Sum(1 / zf) AS s FROM ER
SELECT Count(*) AS c, Sum(1 / zm) AS s FROM ER
SELECT Sum(1 / zm) AS s FROM ER WHERE id <> 100
SELECT Sum(1 / zm) AS s FROM ER WHERE id < 100
SELECT Sum(1 / zm) AS s FROM ER WHERE id <= 100
SELECT Sum(e) AS s FROM (SELECT TOP 10 1 / zm AS e FROM ER)
SELECT Sum(e) AS s FROM (SELECT TOP 150 1 / zm AS e FROM ER ORDER BY id)
SELECT Sum(e) AS s FROM (SELECT 1 / zm AS e FROM ER WHERE id < 50)
SELECT id Mod 2 AS p, Sum(1 / zm) AS s FROM ER GROUP BY id Mod 2
SELECT id \ 100 AS b, Sum(1 / zm) AS s FROM ER GROUP BY id \ 100
SELECT id \ 100 AS b, Sum(1 / zm) AS s FROM ER GROUP BY id \ 100 HAVING Sum(1 / zm) > 0
SELECT CLng(tx) AS v, Count(*) AS n FROM ER GROUP BY CLng(tx)
SELECT DISTINCT 1 / zm AS e FROM ER
